$docs.$self: Configuration for the commerce-catalog install declared in ../../modules.json. modules.json owns whether the module is on, at which version, and on which surfaces; this file owns only how the catalog behaves once it is on, so a tenant can be re-pointed without editing the manifest.
$docs.schemaVersion: Version of this artifact's contract, not the module version.
$docs.moduleId: The registry key this artifact configures; it must match the modules.json entry that names this path.
$docs.sources: Tenant-root files onboarding seeds the catalog from. Paths are relative to tenants/<slug>/ because the module owns the meaning of the files, not their location.
$docs.folderLevels: How deep the category tree may nest. A flat menu sets both to 0; the coffee-shop blueprint allows up to 5.
$docs.resourceKinds: Which kinds of catalog resource this tenant authors. Narrowing the list hides the rest from HQ rather than deleting anything, so an over-broad default is safe to tighten later.
